sources.evidence: 讀了 Description、Getting There 與路線清單（未讀照片說明與留言）。Description：「Seonin-bong is located in Dobongsan, which is located in the northeastern part of Bukhansan National Park. Many consider Seonin-bong to have just as many, if not more quality crack routes than Insu-bong with fewer crowds.」Gear：「I would recommend at least a full rack of cams and some wide gear. 60m rope would suffice but a pull cord/tag line would be very useful.」Getting There：「take the 1 line to Dobongsan train station (도봉산역), take the 1 exit, and make your way west towards Dobongsan/Seonin-bong」；自駕段寫道峰山公營停車場「I think 2 or 3,000 won for 1 hour」，並敘述經石窟庵（석굴암）方向接近最左側路線的走法。路線清單 7 Total Climbs，Leopard (표범) 標示 Trad 6 pitches、5.10c。頁面標示 Shared By Chan Kim on Nov 2, 2020。原連結 slug senin-bong 會轉址到 seonin-bong，同一頁。
